name: miqa-remote
description: Connects Claude to a hosted Miqa MCP server over HTTP with your own API key

server_url.title: Miqa MCP server URL
server_url.description: The hosted Miqa MCP server, e.g. https://miqa-mcp-yourco.onrender.com (no trailing /mcp)

api_key.title: Miqa API key
api_key.description: Your own Miqa APIv2 key, created at {your_miqa_server}/manage_app_keys_v2/
